stem.en: How many players from each basketball team are on the court during play?

why.en: 11 is for cricket/football; basketball has 5 per team on court.

explanation.en: Each basketball team has 5 players on the court.

stem.en: In Volleyball, three consecutive contacts with the ball by the same team are allowed.

explanation.en: A team may hit the ball up to three times before returning it over the net.

stem.en: In Cricket, what is the sole duty of the 'twelfth man'?

text.en: To act as a substitute fielder

whyWrong.en: The twelfth man cannot bowl, bat, or keep wicket.

explanation.en: The twelfth man serves only as a substitute fielder.

stem.en: How many minutes is each half of a standard Football match?

why.en: A football match has two halves of 45 minutes each.

explanation.en: Each half lasts 45 minutes (90 minutes total).

stem.en: What is the width between football goalposts (in metres)?

why.en: 2.44 m is the height of the crossbar.

explanation.en: The distance between football goalposts is 7.32 metres.

stem.en: In Field Hockey, when is a corner awarded to the attacking team?

text.en: When the ball goes over the backline after last being touched by a defender
When the attacker scores a goal
When the goalkeeper saves with pads outside

whyWrong.en: A corner is for a defender sending the ball over their own backline.

explanation.en: Corners are taken from the 22.90 m line when a defender last touches the ball over the backline.

stem.en: In Volleyball, a player is allowed to catch and throw the ball.

explanation.en: Catching and throwing the ball is a fault; it must be hit cleanly.

stem.en: How many personal fouls disqualify a player in Basketball?

why.en: Chapter 6 states each player is allowed 5 personal fouls before disqualification.

explanation.en: A player is disqualified after 5 personal fouls.
